title: XTI Aerospace Reaches Agreement to Restructure $4.5 Million of Promissory Notes
summary: FORT LAUDERDALE, Fla., Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- XTI Aerospace, Inc. (Nasdaq: XTIA) ("XTI Aerospace," "XTI," or the "Company"),…...
body_markdown:
FORT LAUDERDALE, Fla.


, Oct. 29, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- XTI Aerospace, Inc. (Nasdaq: XTIA) ("XTI Aerospace," "XTI," or the "Company"), an aerospace and advanced technology platform and parent company of Drone Nerds, LLC, ("Drone Nerds"), a leading drone solutions platform serving commercial, enterprise and government customers, today announced that it has reached a non-binding agreement to restructure and amend the terms of certain promissory notes issued on November 10, 2025 in connection with the acquisitions of Drone Nerds, LLC and Anzu Robotics, LLC (the "Seller Notes").


The Seller Notes, of which approximately $4.5 million in aggregate principal and capitalized interest remain outstanding, went into default on October 11, 2026. The restructured Seller Notes are expected to extend the maturity date and provide additional financial flexibility as the Company continues to execute on its restructuring strategy.


Under the non-binding term sheet, the Seller Notes will bear interest at a rate of 8.5% per annum, effective as of June 30, 2026, amortizing monthly over 60 months. Notwithstanding the foregoing, a balloon payment of all principal and accrued interest shall be payable on September 30, 2028. At any time during the first 12 months that the Seller Notes are outstanding, XTI shall have the option to elect to pay interest in kind ("PIK") until the Notes are paid in full.


In addition to the non-binding agreement to restructure and amend the terms of the Seller Notes, the Company continues to have constructive conversations regarding its revolving credit facility with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., and is optimistic regarding the outcome of these discussions.


Additional details and provisions of the refinanced Seller Notes will be forthcoming once the documentation summarized in the Term Sheet is fully drafted and executed by the respective parties.


**About XTI Aerospace, Inc.**


XTI Aerospace, Inc. ("XTI") (Nasdaq: XTIA) is focused on building a leading platform for commercial and government drone adoption in the growing unmanned aircraft systems ("UAS") industry. Through its subsidiary, Drone Nerds, LLC, XTI supports enterprise and government customers in sectors including public safety, agriculture, construction, and energy across the drone program lifecycle, from hardware sourcing and deployment to training, service, repair, and the proprietary Always Flying™ program. Its established U.S. customer base and reputation as a trusted solutions provider position the company as a go-to-market partner for drone manufacturers and software developers seeking to scale in the domestic market.
